name: ainet_load_from_zrd
description: AINet::LoadFromZrd loads a numbered AI network ZRD, parses net parameters and nodes, resolves neighbor links, and frees the loaded tree on success.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent AINet source-cluster pass because the retail body depends on VC inline string-copy shape, CRT import scheduling, and adjacent AINet list/node ownership code.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x403040 validates fastcall ECX=netId, net_%02d/net_%02d.zrd path construction, version 105 check, ai_net.cpp line 0x8c error return on version mismatch, AINet::Alloc, typed field writes through offsets 0x00..0x4c, node_00..node_98 probing, 0x30-byte AINetNode allocation, node payload parsing, ResolveNeighborLinksAndBuildProbeFans, FreeLoadedTree on success, and returning the AINet pointer.

The native smoke writes a real net_07.zrd file, runs AINet::LoadFromZrd through zReader::LoadNodeFromPath, verifies parsed identity/type/strategy/buddy/timing fields, node list creation, cost/type payload storage, neighbor index resolution, probe fan allocation, and cleanup through AINet::FreeAll.
